name: Jay Rajput
title: Social Media Manager
bio: I'm a Social Media Manager focused on Instagram, short-form content and digital storytelling. I work at the intersection of strategy, creativity and internet culture — turning ideas into content people actually stop to watch, share and remember.
shortBio: Social Media Manager focused on Instagram, content, strategy and growth. I turn ideas into content people stop scrolling for.

about.story: I'm a social media manager who works where internet culture, storytelling and strategy meet. I run Instagram communities at Creativefuel, have worked on campaigns for Flipkart, Amazon Now, Tecno, Mirzapur and ARTBAT, and built pages of my own from zero. What I've learned: good social is about understanding people, spotting the moment, and making something they stop for, relate to and share.
about.philosophy: Content shouldn't just fill the feed. It should make people feel something.
